name: Dreams to Catch
source:
A mysterious beauty unexpectedly enters the MC's life and changes it.
Become the MC and make decisions for him on this adventure.
While progressing through the game, you will discover the mysteries of the MC's past and future.
There are multiple endings to explore. As the game progresses, many locations will open up to investigate.
This game combines fiction, Fantasy, and Sci-fi and is a sequel to My Dream Girls and A Split Existence.​
translation:
一位神秘的美女意外地闯入了主持人的生活并改变了他的生活。
成为MC并为他在这次冒险中做出决定。
在游戏的过程中，你会发现MC的过去和未来的奥秘。
有多种结局可供探索。随着游戏的进行，许多地点将开放以供调查。
该游戏结合了小说、奇幻和科幻，是《我的梦想女孩》和《分裂的存在》的续集。
